paul-seo.text: Supports policies that build more housing responsibly and cut red tape, while protecting neighborhoods and respecting high-risk fire zones.
Will work to increase funding for more police, deputy sheriffs, prosecutors, peace officers and Highway Patrol officers, and to improve community-based policing and combat gun violence.
Says government must hold homelessness initiatives accountable, cut red tape, and work faster to get people off the streets and into safe, stable housing or mental healthcare programs.
Supports investing more in clean, renewable energy like wind and solar, holding polluters accountable, and protecting clean air and water near ports and airports.
Describes himself as a strong supporter of the Affordable Care Act who 'believes deeply in universal healthcare'; will work to expand coverage for those who need it.
Strong supporter of 2024 Prop. 1 enshrining abortion rights in the state constitution; says he will fully fund Planned Parenthood and community clinics and protect abortion access.
Will work with teachers to increase educator pay, reduce class sizes and modernize campuses; supports full-time community college faculty hiring and student support programs.

A dues-paying union member, says he will be a partner and advocate for local small businesses, cutting red tape and burdensome bureaucratic processes, and wants an economic environment where California businesses big and small can thrive.
Promises to make life more affordable by cracking down on unfair price hikes and providing tax relief for middle-class families.
Endorsed by California Professional Firefighters, Association for Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs, Los Angeles Police Protective League, and LA County Professional Peace Officers Association.
Endorsed by California Federation of Labor Unions, SEIU California, and IATSE.
Endorsed by Sierra Club and Planned Parenthood Advocacy Project LA County Action Fund.

sara-deen.text: Priority: balance the state budget by restoring fiscal discipline, closing unfair tax loopholes, and pursuing responsible non-tax revenue sources.
